title: Chapter 185 Dragon King Underground Palace
content:
Chapter 185 Dragon King Underground Palace

Wang Shuo thought about it and decided that this place was too far from his village, so he chose to destroy it directly.

[Silver Village Construction Order +1, Reputation +100. ]

He searched for 2 silver village construction orders and more than 200 shelter hearts from the warehouse.

And there were a lot of other resources, including 2 military camp construction drawings, 3-level energy converters, etc.

Wang Shuo asked people to count the supplies and take away everything that could be taken away, almost emptying the entire Fengze Village.

The biggest gain this time was of course the population, including soldiers, craftsmen, and some special life professionals, totaling more than 1,800 people.

The total population of Wana Village also exceeded the 3,000 mark.

Wang Shuo checked the conditions for upgrading the territory.

There was no prompt, which made Wang Shuo a little confused.

It seems that everyone is stuck at this step.

Wang Shuo shook his head and laughed.

After returning to the territory, Wang Shuo came to the central square. At this time, there were already dozens of square meters of ground, the land was blackened, and the vegetation was dead.

Wang Shuo looked worried and frowned.

Wang Shuo returned to the meeting room and calmed down alone, trying to sort out his thoughts. There were too many things happening recently.

Duan Wenxi and others were very busy.

They were responsible for the naturalization of the people, accommodation, and work.

As for the surrendered soldiers, Wang Shuo had already arranged them. After registering their household registration, several Ayubu and Baililiang were responsible for selecting them and recruiting them into their own troops.

Wang Shuo took out three pieces of treasure map fragments from his backpack.

When Wang Shuo put the three pieces together, something strange happened.

They quickly combined into a whole, with a clear map drawn on it.

At the same time, a CG animation appeared in front of him.

The overwhelming skeleton beasts and undead soldiers were frantically attacking a 60-meter-high city wall. On the city gate, the three ancient characters "Black Dragon City" were written in the language of the North Sea Empire.

Near the city wall, countless huge skeleton beasts, with their bodies as strong as mountains, suddenly hit the city wall, causing it to shake and the soldiers on it to stand unsteadily. Some soldiers even fell directly off the city wall and were drowned by the skeleton army.

The defensive light curtain above the city kept changing colors, but red was the main color. Countless flying beasts kept attacking, and the defensive light curtain was rippling.

On the city gate tower, a man wearing a crown and extraordinary bravery looked at the fierce battle in front of him with a cold face.

Approaching, a general in armor said anxiously: "Lord City Lord, retreat! Black Dragon City...cannot be defended!"

A passage of text from the North Sea Empire slowly emerged.

Wang Shuo can now barely read, and he can also understand the general meaning of the text he doesn't know by "looking up the dictionary".

"In the 9938th year of the Imperial Calendar, the world was in chaos. The North Sea Empire fell apart under the situation of internal and external troubles. The various fiefdoms broke away from the North Sea Empire's royal court. After another 10 years, Black Dragon City was besieged. The Black Dragon King struggled for 6 years before the city was broken."

At the end of the picture, there was a loud noise.

Several important parts of Black Dragon City, such as the City Lord's Mansion, the Armory, the Barracks and other important buildings, rose directly from the ground and flew in all directions.

Wang Shuo was overwhelmed by the scene and could not calm down for a long time.

The magnificence of Black Dragon City deeply shocked him.

However, such a huge city still could not escape the fate of being destroyed, which was really a pity.

At this time, the treasure map in Wang Shuo's hand turned into the layout of the Dragon King's underground palace.

He recalled it carefully and found that this was clearly the Lord's Mansion of Black Dragon City.
